summary: Frontend-only testing of /practice root + Review session redesign (UX/UI #4). All functional specs verified: RECOMMENDED card data-states (due/caught-up/empty), review session focus mode, completion counters, mode navigation, i18n ES/DE, no horizontal overflow at 390px, regression smoke across /home,/learn,/progress,/more. Full 6-item session executed for test guest (dc7d6048) with mix of ratings (again/good/good/easy/good/easy) landing on completion screen (reviewed=6, correct count accurate per data-correct attributes), Done returns to /practice root, state transitioned to caught-up (due count 0) matching backend API.
critical_code_review_comments: Practice.js (554 lines) is above the 700-line threshold target but still readable; consider splitting ReviewSession/QuestionRenderer/Feedback into /pages/practice/* modules in a future pass.
premiumParam() recreates object each render; included in load() closure via billing.customerInfo dep — safe but worth memoizing if parent re-renders become costly.
QuestionRenderer uses Math.random() inside useMemo for word_ordering shuffle; deterministic enough per-item but will reshuffle on content identity change (acceptable here).

Mid-session X close path was not clicked live (no fresh due items available after full session; next_review_at ~6 min out) but onEnd wiring is identical to Done (setSession(null)+load) which was validated to navigate back to /practice root — functionally equivalent.
test_credentials: Anonymous guest via localStorage iph_guest_id. Used dc7d6048-96f7-4518-9970-d57f0ba4933e (6 due items) and created 91a34c49-8ef9-4a14-9ad7-9a9aee4d3da9 (empty state).
seed_data_creation: Created one empty-state guest via POST /api/guests + PUT /api/guests/{id}/profile with role=waiter, venue_type=pub, target_country=ireland, goal=work_abroad.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Guest dc7d6048 is now caught-up (0 due) after this test consumed its 6 due items; one item re-enters due state ~6 min later (SRS). If future tests need a due queue, mint a fresh guest and generate mistakes via exercise submissions, or wait for scheduled next_review_at. Language switcher at /more uses data-testid=more-language-block + more-language-option-{code}. i18n keys practice.* and review.* are present in es/de/en bundles with zero raw-key leaks on /practice.
